<!-- Thanks for contributing! One startup (or investor / lab) per pull request, please. -->

**What this adds or changes**

- [ ] New entry
- [ ] Correction to an existing entry
- [ ] Something else (maintainers only, if it touches files outside `data/`)

**Entry:** `data/cities/<city>/startups/<id>.yaml`

**Checklist**

- [ ] It's a deep-tech company in one of the categories in `data/taxonomy.yaml`
- [ ] It's listed in the city where its headquarters is (one file per company, not one per office)
- [ ] `source` links to a public page confirming it exists and is based here
- [ ] `stage`, if set, is backed by that source
- [ ] `last_verified` is today's date
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally (optional; CI runs it too)
